cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 835, you are approaching TOL, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 835，接近 TOL，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, approaching TOL, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，接近 TOL，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, radar contact, descend and maintain 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，雷达识别，下降并保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS warning was triggered, you are executing TCAS climbing, inform this situation to Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 TCAS 告警触发，你正在按 TCAS 爬升，向上海管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, our TCAS warning was triggered, TCAS climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，TCAS 告警触发，正在按 TCAS 爬升。

cards.audioText: UAL 835, roger, the conflicting traffic is military, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 835，收到，冲突航空器为军用航空器，脱离冲突后报告。

cards.audioText: During TCAS maneuver, the cabin crew reports you have two serious and three minor injuries on board, make an urgency call to Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 在 TCAS 机动期间，客舱机组报告机上有两人重伤、三人轻伤，向上海管制发出紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL 835, we have two serious and threes minor injuries on board during T CAS maneuver.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，上海管制，UAL 835，在 TCAS 机动期间，我们机上有两人重伤、三人轻伤。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of the conflicting, contact Shanghai Control and request resume descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离冲突，联系上海管制，请求恢复下降。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 835, clear of conflict, request resume descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 835，已脱离冲突，请求恢复下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, roger, descend to 5100 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，收到，下降至 5100 米，联系武汉管制120.35。

cards.audioText: now you are passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3566, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3566，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 835, passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 835，正通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 5100 meters, you have got information G, make initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 ZF，保持 5100 米，已收到通播 G，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 835, over ZF, maintaining 5100 meters, information G.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 835，飞越 ZF，保持 5100 米，收到通播 G。

cards.audioText: UAL 835, radar contact, turn right, direct to XSH, expect XSH-03A arrival and radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 835，雷达识别，右转直飞 XSH，预计执行 XSH-03A 进场，并接受雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to XSH, expect XSH03 A arrival, radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 XSH，预计执行 XSH-03A 进场，雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, UAL 835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米，UAL 835。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 835, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell Wuhan Approach that you need ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 835，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉武汉进近，落地后需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: We need ambulances on arrival, UAL 835.

cards.audioText: C: UAL 835, ambulance will be ready upon your arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 835，救护车将在你到达时准备好。

cards.audioText: UAL 835, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 835，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，建立后报告。
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 835。

cards.audioText: Now you have established on ILS Runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 835, established on ILS Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 835，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
